budget.excludes: Imports, model loading, process start/cleanup, audits, failed pilots, host contention and overruns; not an elapsed-time forecast.

parameter_selection: No choices based on pilot objective values; proposed horizons/seeds are protocol settings, not an approved compute allocation.

statistics.primary_endpoint: Mean over instances of mean paired-seed feasibility-then-fleet win score (+1 treatment win, -1 loss, 0 tie; both failures separately counted).
statistics.distance: Secondary original-TD gaps only at valid paired-seed matched fleets; report exact denominator. Never compare TD across different fleets.
statistics.resampling: 10000 approximate paired cluster-bootstrap replicates, RNG seed 20261019: resample geometry groups within each size, keep all members; resample five seed labels jointly across every algorithm/cutoff in each replicate; retain original size-stratum weights.
statistics.multiplicity: Primary 300s comparisons: 3 simultaneous Bonferroni percentile intervals; ablation 300s: separate family of 8. Other horizons/contrasts descriptive. No p-values computed here.
statistics.limitations: Only 4 geometry groups per size and 5 seed labels: approximate intervals, no power/coverage guarantee. Undefined matched-TD bootstrap draws are retained as undefined; suppress that interval if any draw lacks a denominator. All-failure ties are not quality ties.

failure_policy: Retain every declared cell. No-solution/known algorithm failures count in availability and paired fleet score. Input/source/config/model integrity errors invalidate protocol inference, never become ordinary solver losses. Pre-cutoff certification and return latency are separate gates; no score-based reruns or cutoff-prefix reuse.
execution_policy: No executor/commands in this artifact. Fresh process and empty archive per independent cutoff; solve-scope construction/inference/online updates/certification charged; setup/model-load/end-to-end recorded separately; sequential one-thread-requested blocks, no sleep padding. Each future child requests its own initially empty NUMBA_CACHE_DIR; compilation after solve entry is charged; operational validation must include this policy.
